metadata.description: App Store Connect through Heimdall: one plug-in per area, plus the skill.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Skill
plugins.description: The Heimdall skill: what the servers below can do, which one owns what, and how to stay inside the credential boundary. Install it with whichever areas you pick.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Access
plugins.description: Team and tester access: beta groups, individual testers, invitations, team members.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Analytics
plugins.description: Sales and finance reports, analytics report requests, performance metrics.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC App Clips
plugins.description: App Clips: default and advanced experiences, header images, beta invocations.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC App Info
plugins.description: App identity and store metadata: names, bundle IDs, categories, availability, age ratings, accessibility labels, the end user license agreement, Android-to-iOS mapping.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Background Assets
plugins.description: Background Assets (iOS 26): asset packs downloaded outside the app binary.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Distribution
plugins.description: Release pipeline: App Store versions, localizations, phased releases, review submissions, builds, export compliance, EU alternative distribution.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Game Center
plugins.description: Game Center: achievements, leaderboards, activities, challenges, matchmaking.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Marketing
plugins.description: Store presence: screenshots, previews, custom product pages, in-app events, customer reviews.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Monetization
plugins.description: Money: subscriptions, in-app purchases, offers, app pricing, StoreKit 2 transactions.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Provisioning
plugins.description: Code signing infrastructure: bundle IDs, certificates, devices, provisioning profiles.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC TestFlight
plugins.description: TestFlight build metadata: beta app localizations, review details, crash feedback, the beta license agreement testers accept.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Webhooks
plugins.description: Webhooks pushing App Store Connect events to your endpoint.

plugins.name: Heimdall · ASC Xcode Cloud
plugins.description: Apple's CI/CD: workflows, build runs, artifacts, source control.
